newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC clears DMCI preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC clears DMCI preferred shares.

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said on Friday it had approved the sale of 2.4 million preferred shares of construction concern DMCI Holdings Inc.
The shares, which will be offered at 1,000 pesos each, will be convertible to common shares at a 10 percent premium over the average price of the share five days prior to the pricing date.
The company will have to buy back the preferred shares at the end of five years from the issue date. It can also redeem those shares starting on the second year.
The proceeds of the offer, amounting to 2.33 billion pesos, will be used to fund the company's various infrastructure projects and acquisitions, the SEC said.
